_purpose: Pre-registered adoption thresholds for the pairwise verifier. Written BEFORE running the clean-subset comparison. Editing these after seeing results invalidates the experiment.

_notes.min_auroc_gain: pooled OOF AUROC must beat the SAME-SUBSET baseline by >=0.03; comparing against the old 0.702 on the old mixed labels would not be a fair test
_notes.min_folds_improved_frac: improvement must hold in >=80% of folds, so it is not driven by one fold or recording
_notes.min_coverage_at_90: coverage at 0.90 precision must be materially non-zero (v1 gave 0.006), otherwise there is still no usable auto-keep branch
_notes.max_worst_fold_drop: the worst fold must not degrade by more than 0.05 vs the baseline's worst fold
